d: Indian stock markets face a sharp sell-off as Sensex and Nifty come under pressure from rising US Treasury yields, shifting Fed rate expectations, crude oil above $100 a barrel and renewed Iran-US tensions. Meanwhile, India has ordered 160 Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons (SAAW), strengthening its long-range strike capabilities. The satellite-guided SAT-SAAW can target runways, radars, bunkers and hangars and is compatible with aircraft including the Su-30MKI, Jaguar and Hawk. Hem Saroya explains the market turmoil and India’s latest defence push on Vantage on Firstpost.
